verdict.rationale: Out-of-office is documented: Reclaim can be told when you're on vacation or OOO, with options for continuing Tasks/Habits during that time, and makes OOO visibility automatic. Ad-hoc availability changes are possible through the #reclaim_free no-meeting-day and #reclaim_busy hashtags, and scheduling links share your availability. However, nothing in the pack documents defining working-hours schedules, and the date overrides are hashtag workarounds rather than a dedicated availability-schedule editor. Missing for 10: documented working-hours/availability schedule configuration, a first-class date-override mechanism, independent corroboration.
